medium.en: Hanging scroll; ink and light color on paper

dimensions.en: Painting: 39 x 52 cm (15 3/8 x 20 1/2 in.); Overall with knobs: 167 x 76 cm (65 3/4 x 29 15/16 in.)

intro.zh: 石涛生于明朝宗室，明亡后出家为僧，1693年改信道教，回到扬州，直到1707年去世。
intro.en: Shitao was born into the Ming imperial clan, became a Buddhist monk after the dynasty fell, turned to Daoism in 1693 and returned to Yangzhou, where he died in 1707.

intro.zh: 1697年春天，他画了这幅画，送给即将远赴福建海边的汪牧庭。
intro.en: In spring 1697 he painted this for Wang Muting, who was about to leave for the coast of Fujian.

intro.zh: 题诗从扬子桥边的江水和柳丝写起，感叹自己老去、朋友星散。
intro.en: His poem begins with the river and willows by the Yangzi Bridge and laments growing old as friends scatter.

intro.zh: 落款还向学使思白致意。
intro.en: His inscription also sends greetings to Sibai, the education commissioner.

look_for.zh: 画上方石涛自题的长诗。
look_for.en: Shitao's long poem written across the top of the painting.

look_for.zh: 雾中的江岸、松树和房屋。
look_for.en: The misty riverbank with pines and houses.

look_for.zh: 下方另裱的后人题跋；馆方记录有何瑗玉和李心慧的题跋。
look_for.en: The later colophon mounted below; the museum records colophons by He Yuanyu and Li Xinhui.

views.zh: 石涛在题诗中说，千里万里的山水都在笔端显现，那不是墨也不是烟，只是寄托自己的傲气。
views.en: In his poem Shitao says that however vast the scene, it appears at the tip of his brush: not ink, not mist, but a way to lodge his pride.

quote.en: not ink, nor mist, but rather a way to lodge my pride

insc.title: Inscriptions, colophons and seals, as transcribed and translated by the museum (1954.126)

alt.zh: 一幅立轴：画心是雾蒙蒙的江岸，有松树、房屋和远山，上方写满题诗；下方另裱一段题跋。
alt.en: A hanging scroll: a misty riverbank with pines, houses and distant hills, a poem filling the top, and a separate colophon mounted below.

note.zh: 每一句都对照所注出处核对过；找不到可靠出处的说法已删去或改写。
note.en: Every sentence was checked against the sources it cites; claims without a reliable source were cut or rewritten.
